record_title: Reverse-order averaging cancels first-order underrelaxation bias in cyclic block Kaczmarz
limitations: Finite-dimensional orthogonal projectors are assumed, with sum_i P_i positive definite and lambda tending to zero. The result is an asymptotic bias statement, not a complexity or performance guarantee. The full text of Censor--Eggermont--Gordon (1983) and Popa (1995) was not inspected end-to-end, leaving residual originality risk; generic forward/reverse symmetrization is also known in operator-splitting time integration.
